g.text: TraceHome · AWS architecture · Uploading a photo
Target design · one Region, two Availability Zones · nothing in the VPC is reachable from the internet · every background job is queued, retried, and never lost
EDGE · AWS GLOBAL NETWORK, IN FRONT OF THE REGION
AMAZON S3 · every file in 3+ zones · versioning on
NAT gateway only · route to the internet gateway
no internet route · NACL allows the app subnets only
no internet route · NACL allows the app subnets only
private app subnets in both zones · reached only through CloudFront
B1 Route 53 answers with CloudFront's address
B2 HTTPS to CloudFront; WAF checks every request
B3 Photos come from the CloudFront cache
B4 Other requests reach the internal load balancer
B5 Load balancer → app in either zone → search
U1 One transaction: credit, ledger, unlock, outbox
U2 Outbox relay reads new events
U3 Publishes to the SQS worker queue through
U4 Delivery worker sends the lead to the CRM
U5 Failures retry, then go to a DLQ with an alarm
P1 App gives the phone a presigned upload URL
P2 Phone uploads straight to the incoming bucket
P5 Lambda + Rekognition check, resize, strip GPS
P6 Approved → photos bucket; flags → review case
R1 A zone fails: the load balancer uses the other
zone; the database standby takes over (1–2 min)
R2 Workers restart in the other zone; queued work
R3 Dead-letter queues hold failed work; alarms fire
R4 Backups are copied to a second Region
